# Jagananmol Daneti

> Portfolio of Jagananmol Daneti: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering student with Honours in AI and Machine Learning at Symbiosis Institute of Technology, Pune (graduating 2027), and Forward Deployed Engineer at Prodapt. Full-stack (MERN), multi-agent AI and blockchain. Hosted on AWS Amplify Hosting.

The site is a single page with five sections. Its creative feature, "Ask my portfolio", routes a visitor's question through a router and a validator to one of five agents, and refuses rather than guesses, like his multi-agent project G-One. A "Surprise me" button turns his name into a 3D robot that walks visitors through his journey.

Key facts:
- Education: 93% in the ICSE board exam (2020); 93 percentile in MHT-CET; B.Tech CSE with Honours in AI and ML at SIT Pune, graduating 2027.
- Work: Forward Deployed Engineer at Prodapt, taking AI from demo to production with client teams.
- Hackathons: 3rd Prize at Hack Your Path 6.0 (HITAM, Hyderabad, May 2025); 2nd Runner-up at AGTechathon 1.0 2k25 (A. G. Patil Institute of Technology, Solapur, June 2025).
- Program: completed the six-month VOIS Innovation Marathon 2.0 with G-One, a multi-agent assistant.
- Contact: jagananmoldaneti@gmail.com
